services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: Inshore trips that target Striped Bass and Bluefish will leave the dock early in the morning in order to maximize the morning bite. Leaving early in the morning provides the best chance to catch our own live bait. This makes for an exciting morning. We like to use light tackle gear when targeting bass and bluefish. Bluefin Tuna fishing is for the serious people that want a chance to catch a fish of a lifetime. Although we do not catch bluefins on every trip, we do provide the experience, attentions to detail, and dedication to giving the best chance possible to catching tuna.
